# Film Storyboards

> > A professional storyboard portfolio showcasing commercial, historical, and concept design work by Drawers Surplus, featuring projects for film production, advertising campaigns, and museum installations.

This Tumblr blog documents storyboard work across advertising (Ford, NMBS), historical interpretation (Battle of Aljubarrota Interpretation Centre in Portugal), and concept design projects. The portfolio demonstrates both traditional and digital storyboarding techniques, including work with Manga Studio and animatic development.

## Key Topics

- Shooting storyboards

- [Ford Commercial Storyboard](https://film-storyboards.tumblr.com/post/64015850683/advertising-shooting-storyboard-director-david): Ford commercial storyboard by David Lodge for RSA Films UK

## Historical & Museum Projects

- [Battle of Aljubarrota Installation Design](https://film-storyboards.tumblr.com/post/58688267507/concept-design-for-an-installation-for-the-battle): Concept design for Battle of Aljubarrota Interpretation Centre, Portugal
- [Aljubarrota Animatic Storyboards](https://film-storyboards.tumblr.com/post/49166532482/extracts-from-animatic-storyboards-series-done-for): Animatic storyboards for Aljubarrota Battle Centre audio-guides
- [Portuguese Interregnum Animatic](https://film-storyboards.tumblr.com/post/48842630755/portuguese-interregnum-illustrated-in-animatic): Portuguese Interregnum animatic featuring Ferdinand I and Queen Leonor
